title: The Hobb Network
description: We are working on a "real life simulator" experience in Minecraft. Here you can roleplay but also actually perform work, tasks, buy things & more!
body:
# The Hobb Network

**The Hobb Network** is a Minecraft server focused on creating an immersive **real-life inspired gameplay experience**. Our main gamemode is currently in **early development**, but the goal is to build a world where players can experience systems that resemble aspects of real life inside Minecraft.

Instead of traditional survival or minigames, the server focuses on **progression, economy, and player interaction**.

## Core Concept

The main gamemode is designed as a **"real-life simulator"** where players gradually build their in-game life through work, money, property, and interaction with others.

Planned systems include:

- **Player-driven economy**
- **Jobs and work systems** to earn in-game money
- **Starter tasks** to help new players begin their journey
- **Housing and property ownership**
- **Vehicles and transportation**
- **Custom items and mechanics**
- **Roleplay-oriented features**

## Development Status

The server is **actively being developed**, meaning many systems are still evolving. Early players will be able to:

- Experience new features as they are added
- Help test gameplay systems
- Provide feedback that can influence future development

## Contributing

Because the project is still growing, we are also interested in people who enjoy **building, creating custom assets, or contributing ideas**. If you like designing environments, structures, or custom content, there may be opportunities to help shape parts of the world.

## Vision

The long-term goal of **The Hobb Network** is to create a **persistent world where players can build a virtual life**, interact through an evolving economy, and progress through meaningful systems rather than simple gameplay loops.
